findings.current: The difference was exactly half a step.
findings.defect: The wording leaves both the action and the two things being compared unclear; the source means Cheongpung avoided the strike by a margin of half a step.
findings.rationale: The surrounding action establishes that the half-step is the narrow margin by which Cheongpung evades the descending sword.
findings.replacement: Cheongpung had dodged it by exactly half a step.

findings.current: The Taiji Wisdom Sword was Wudang’s most renowned supreme technique, famous enough that even I had heard of it several times.
findings.defect: The draft changes 최고의, which establishes the technique as Wudang’s greatest art, into “most renowned,” reducing a hierarchy claim to one of fame.
findings.rationale: 최고의 절기 identifies the Taiji Wisdom Sword as Wudang’s greatest secret technique; its fame is conveyed separately by 유명한.
findings.replacement: The Taiji Wisdom Sword was Wudang’s greatest secret art, famous enough that even I had heard of it a few times.
findings.source: 태극혜검은 나도 몇 번 들어 봤을 정도로 유명한 무당파 최고의 절기.

findings.current: It was only a single clash, but the victor was obvious.
findings.defect: The draft declares a victor even though the duel is still underway; the source says only that the advantage in this clash was clear.
findings.rationale: 우세 denotes superiority or the advantage at that point, not the final victor of the duel.
findings.replacement: It was only a single clash, but who held the advantage was obvious.
findings.source: 검기와 검기의 충돌. 단 한 번의 격돌이었지만 우세는 명백했다.

findings.current: And exactly fifteen minutes later, Gung Gibang’s eyes swollen shut, he clung to my calf and shouted,
findings.defect: The draft adds that Gung Gibang’s eyes are swollen shut, making the injury more severe than the source states.
findings.rationale: 눈이 퉁퉁 부어오른 means his eyes are badly swollen or puffy; it does not say that the swelling has forced them shut.
findings.replacement: And exactly fifteen minutes later, Gung Gibang, his eyes swollen and puffy, clung to my calf and shouted,
findings.source: 그리고 정확히 일각 후, 눈이 퉁퉁 부어오른 궁기방이 내 종아리를 붙들고 외쳤다.

findings.current: “Of course I remember you. I mean, of course I do!”
findings.defect: The repeated English clauses do not convey the joke that Cheongpung catches himself using a polite sentence ending and switches to Jongni Chu’s casual register.
findings.rationale: The correction from 말고요 to 말고 is an explicit shift from polite to casual speech as Cheongpung tries to match his new friend’s familiarity.
findings.replacement: “Of course I remember you. Of course I do—uh, yeah, of course!”

findings.current: “Sorry. I’ll go easy on you. I mean, I’ll go easy on you.”
findings.defect: The identical repetition erases Cheongpung’s second deliberate correction from polite speech to the casual, friend-like register Jongni Chu uses.
findings.rationale: The change from 할게요 to 하겠네 is the point of the self-correction and continues the earlier joke about Cheongpung awkwardly adopting Jongni Chu’s informal manner.
findings.replacement: “Sorry. I’ll go easy on you. No, wait—sorry, pal. I’ll go easy on you.”

findings.current: *He’s incredible. His natural talent is so extraordinary that it’s hard to believe it’s purely innate.*
findings.defect: The English is logically tautological because natural talent is inherently innate, obscuring the thought that Cheongpung’s achievements are hard to attribute solely to inborn ability.
findings.rationale: The source expresses disbelief that Cheongpung’s extraordinary ability can be explained entirely by the talent he was born with.
findings.replacement: *He’s incredible. It’s hard to believe all of that comes purely from natural talent.*
findings.source: ‘대단하다. 순전히 타고난 재능이라는 것이 믿기지 않을 정도로.’

findings.current: He pointed a bamboo staff polished by years of handling at me and continued.
findings.defect: “Polished” suggests a clean or glossy surface, while 손때 묻은 describes an object visibly marked and worn by frequent handling.
findings.rationale: The source emphasizes the accumulated marks of use on Gung Gibang’s staff, not that handling has polished it.
findings.replacement: He pointed a well-worn bamboo staff at me and continued.
findings.source: 그는 손때 묻은 죽장(竹杖)을 내게 겨누며 말을 이었다.

summary: Several semantic and register issues remain, including a premature declaration of victory, loss of Wudang’s martial hierarchy, two omitted speech-level corrections, and an unsupported increase in Gung Gibang’s injury.
